profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at SitScape
profile.summary:
I'm a software engineer at SitScape where I've grown from an intern to a senior engineer over the past few years. My recent works has been mostly focused on AI integration (building RAG and Graph RAG systems, MCP server/client capabilities, and solutions that let clients gather insights from messy data) and lightweight service development and orchestration. I've also led teams through critical release cycles, helped form the code review team, and architected a service platform from scratch.

What I enjoy most about my work is how creative it is. It requires you to take the outlines of an idea and come up with the details and reason and project what the consequences of those details will be. Making these architecture decisions quickly and watching how they hold up under real use gives quick validation of both the ideas and the implementation, which offers an amazing and ceaseless learning opportunity. I tend to gravitate towards projects that require a brand new vision or a new perspective because that's where there is room for creativity even if that creativity manifests as a PR comment.

Outside of work, I like building things that do not really have a need to exist but flex that same creative muscle: topographical map smoothing, card game generation, a multi-threaded simulation exploring whether time dilation would cause gravity. Without the need to align what I do to any set direction, I have the ability to do what I want even if there is no feedback other than my own (though that last example did place 21st in the Summer of Math Exposition 2025). Always happy to connect with people working on interesting problems.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Promoted to Senior Software Engineer in April 2026. Focused on AI integration, platform architecture, and engineering team leadership.
• Ran and managed an engineering team of 8 people for 3 weeks through a critical release cycle, successfully shipping 10 new development tickets for a single fast-paced project and 15 critical release-blocking tickets.
• Delivered 3 new services in the company's service platform in one week relating to runtime service creation with 0 downtime, service auditing, and dependency installation.
• Integrated service creation with terminal-based AI tools, enabling the app development team to self-serve capability gaps.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Co-founded the Code Review team and reviewed a third of all incoming PRs. Implemented an AI-driven review process that inspired the AI-augmented system now used on 75% of PRs.
• Researched and developed AI integration techniques for client-facing demos including RAG and Graph RAG, enabling clients to gather insights from unstructured and semi-structured data.
• Architected and implemented MCP server/client capabilities and bulk document embedding performance improvements for a client-facing AI project as lead engineer. 
• Proposed a service orchestration and publishing architecture and took the project from idea to testable platform in 13 workdays.

positions.title: Junior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Leveraged LangChain and Python to create a multi-threaded server to return structured data from an unstructured, natural language query.
• Enhanced existing AI capabilities by integrating previously internal systems into an MCP architecture
• Implemented a Notion-like widget using EditorJS, enhancing that library to support many new features like multi-select and batch editing
• Drastically reduced performance lag in many places in the codebase, identifying unnecessary algorithmic and syntactic complexity, leading to improvements of up to a 75% reduction of the duration of a set of often-used action

positions.title: Personal goal pursuit
positions.description:
Since I graduated a year ahead of schedule, I gave myself six months to work on personal projects while living in Germany. In addition to being a time to relax and travel, this is also a time where I can dedicate myself to what I enjoy doing without any monetary or financial bias and with the energy to do so completely.

Some of these creative pursuits align well with my career. For example, I created a portfolio website, which is linked below (https://ericknock.dev). I also created a map viewing website, which can be found in the portfolio. I also competed in a number of cybersecurity competitions.

Other of these pursuits are purely personal. I wrote a book or, rather, a collection of short stories along with a number of other articles and musings and designed its cover along with other illustrations and drawings. More details about these pursuits can also be found on the portfolio.

positions.title: Junior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Virginia Beach, Virginia, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Between two periods of travel, I worked for SitScape full time as a Junior Software Engineer specializing in rapid improvement and rapid bug fixes. This was a two month contract. My flexible schedule and  reliable efficiency made me an indispensable part of the team.
• Diagnosed and corrected a months-old faulty merge that went overlooked
• Researched faults in a Continuous Integration pipeline and pinpointed the offending lines of code
• Continued the security research started in my internship
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · HTML · jQuery · Git · PHP · Back-End Web Development · Agile Application Development

positions.title: Travel
positions.description: As a reward to myself for graduating university, I traveled to South Africa and Northwestern Europe. In the 13 different countries I visited, I learned many cultural and personal lessons.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.locationName: Virginia Beach, Virginia, United States · Remote
positions.description:
During my last year of college, I worked as a software engineering intern at SitScape. While I was just intended to use the SitScape software and report any bugs I found, I applied myself and got a fast-track to working directly on the codebase. To do this, I had to quickly learn JavaScript, especially jQuery, and php, which I did not know prior to the internship. I successfully applied them both in the course of the internship.

• Progressed past my original goal for the entire internship in two weeks
• Implemented new features for both the user interface as well as backend processes in a large codebase
• Conducted market and product research to aid in the development of the company
• Learned JavaScript and PHP in a fast paced environment while still completing my assigned tasks
• Improved the usability and speed of the application by over 200% in two distinct areas
• Took initiative to become an important member of the cyber security team. In this position, I reviewed code for potential threats and vulnerabilities and performed penetration tests on the software.
positions.insights: Skills: Cyber Defense · JavaScript · User Interface Design · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · HTML · jQuery · Git · Cybersecurity · Ethical Hacking · Version Control · PHP · Threat Modeling · React · Debugging · Penetration Testing

positions.title: Model Digitalization Technician
positions.description: I worked in a dental laboratory that specialized in making bridges and crowns for dentists. Most of the modeling of these bridges and crowns is done digitally, but the models made of the patients' teeth are physical. My job was to digitalize these models by scanning them into the modeling program through the use of a ZirkonZahn and 3Shape scanning machines.

projects.description: View this site to read details about my career and personal accomplishments and projects. I built the sure using React, making sure that each component I create is modular and extensible. This allows the tool to render other resumes as well with only small modifications to the source code. Though this was my first stand-alone project using React, I completed it in two weeks.

projects.title: 3D Book Model with CSS
projects.description: Using pure CSS and some HTML and JavaScript, I created a 3D model of a book. This model is articulated using CSS variable to be able to open and close with the position of the pages and the skew of the sides of the book being calculated based on the angle of the open pages.
